Environment location

    /lustre/fsn1/projects/rech/ihj/urb54jd/qtaim_embed_private/env/qtaim_embed

YAML files

    /lustre/fsn1/projects/rech/ihj/urb54jd/qtaim_embed_private/env/qtaim_embed.yml
    /lustre/fsn1/projects/rech/ihj/urb54jd/qtaim_embed_private/env/qtaim_embed_prefix.yml

To activate the environment on a login/CPU node

    module purge
    module load miniforge/24.11.3
    source "$(conda info --base)/etc/profile.d/conda.sh"
    conda activate /lustre/fsn1/projects/rech/ihj/urb54jd/qtaim_embed_private/env/qtaim_embed

To check that the environment is active

    python -c "import sys; print(sys.executable)"
    python -c "import torch; print('Torch:', torch.__version__, 'CUDA available:', torch.cuda.is_available())"

*python path should be : /lustre/fsn1/projects/rech/ihj/urb54jd/qtaim_embed_private/env/qtaim_embed/bin/python

To check the CUDA, login to the GPU node:

    srun -A ihj@h100 -p gpu_p6 -C h100 --gres=gpu:1 -c 8 -t 01:00:00 --pty bash 

    Then, activate the env in GPU shell and check PyTorch:
        python -c "import torch; print('Torch:', torch.__version__, 'CUDA available:', torch.cuda.is_available())"

To install and register the Jupyter Kernel

    Actiavte the environment
    Install ipykernel:

        python -m pip install -U pip
        python -m pip install ipykernel
        python -c "import ipykernel; print(ipykernel.__version__)"

    Register the kernel

        python -m ipykernel install --user --name qtaim_embed --display-name "Python (qtaim_embed)"

    Check: jupyter kernelspec list

To use the Jupyter kernel
Restart JupyterHub
Open your notebook
Select the kernel:
Python (qtaim_embed)
